test_cases.test_case: Log in with valid credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: 1. Enter a valid username in the Username field
2. Enter a valid password in the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard with a personalized greeting

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with invalid credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: 1. Enter an invalid username in the Username field
2. Enter an invalid password in the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message is displayed; the password field is cleared and the username remains

test_cases.test_case: Log in with maximum length username and password
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: 1. Enter a username with maximum allowed length in the Username field
2. Enter a password with maximum allowed length in the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard with a personalized greeting

test_cases.test_case: Access My Courses page
steps: 1. Click on 'My Courses' in the top navigation bar
test_cases.expected_result: The My Courses page displays all courses the teacher has access to as visual cards

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access My Courses page without logging in
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page directly
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Access My Courses page with no enrolled courses
preconditions: User logged in as Teacher with no courses
steps: 1. Click on 'My Courses' in the top navigation bar
test_cases.expected_result: An empty state message is displayed indicating no courses are available

test_cases.test_case: Create a new assignment
preconditions: A course exists and Edit mode is enabled
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Click '+ Add an activity or resource'
3. Select Assignment from the Activity Chooser and click Add
4. Enter 'Test Assignment' in the Assignment name field
5. Enable the Due date toggle and select a due date
6. Click 'Save and return to course'
test_cases.expected_result: The assignment appears in the course section with a link

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to create an assignment without a name
preconditions: A course exists and Edit mode is enabled
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Click '+ Add an activity or resource'
3. Select Assignment and click Add
4. Leave the Assignment name field empty
5. Click 'Save and return to course'
test_cases.expected_result: An inline validation error highlights the Assignment name field; the form is not submitted and remains open

test_cases.test_case: Create an assignment with maximum length name
preconditions: A course exists and Edit mode is enabled
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page
2. Click '+ Add an activity or resource'
3. Select Assignment and click Add
4. Enter a name with maximum allowed length in the Assignment name field
5. Click 'Save and return to course'
test_cases.expected_result: The assignment is created successfully and appears in the course section

test_cases.test_case: Toggle Edit mode on the Dashboard
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit mode' toggle button on the Dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: Edit mode is enabled, and the '+ Add a block' button appears

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to toggle Edit mode when already enabled
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit mode' toggle button on the Dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: Edit mode remains enabled; no changes occur

test_cases.test_case: Toggle Edit mode multiple times rapidly
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit mode' toggle button rapidly multiple times
test_cases.expected_result: Edit mode toggles correctly without errors; the state reflects the last toggle

test_cases.test_case: View the Gradebook Grader report
preconditions: At least one course with grades exists
steps: 1. Navigate to the Gradebook from the course page
2. Select 'Grader report' from the report-type selector
test_cases.expected_result: The Grader report displays a spreadsheet-style view of grades

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to view the Gradebook without any grades
preconditions: No grades exist in the course
steps: 1. Navigate to the Gradebook from the course page
2. Select 'Grader report' from the report-type selector
test_cases.expected_result: An empty state message is displayed indicating no grades are available

test_cases.test_case: View Gradebook with maximum number of students
preconditions: Course has maximum allowed students enrolled
steps: 1. Navigate to the Gradebook from the course page
2. Select 'Grader report' from the report-type selector
test_cases.expected_result: The Grader report displays all students without performance issues

test_cases.test_case: Edit profile successfully
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
2. Select 'Profile' from the dropdown
3. Click 'Edit profile'
4. Update the required fields
5. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: Profile is updated successfully and reflects the changes

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to edit profile without required fields
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
2. Select 'Profile' from the dropdown
3. Click 'Edit profile'
4. Leave required fields empty
5. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: An inline validation error highlights the required fields; the form is not submitted

test_cases.test_case: Edit profile with maximum length fields
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
2. Select 'Profile' from the dropdown
3. Click 'Edit profile'
4. Fill all fields with maximum allowed length
5. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: Profile is updated successfully and reflects the changes

test_cases.test_case: Log out successfully
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
2. Select 'Log out' from the dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: User is logged out and redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log out when already logged out
steps: 1. Navigate to any protected page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Log out during an ongoing action
steps: 1. Click on the user's initials icon
2. Select 'Log out' from the dropdown while an action is in progress
test_cases.expected_result: User is logged out and redirected to the login page; any unsaved changes are discarded
